CONNECTOR_SECRET.description: 64 random characters. Make them with your password manager, or run `openssl rand -hex 32`.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your Resend API key. Invitations and sign-in codes go by email, so nobody can set up or sign in without it.

DEPLOY_REPO.description: The name of the repository this makes in your GitHub organisation: keep `second-brain-connector`.

EMAIL_FROM.description: The sender of invitations and sign-in codes, on a domain verified in Resend, such as `Second Brain <brain@yourcompany.com>`.
